title: Meta Stock Trends Following Q2 Earnings Report
description: Meta's stock has been trending following the release of its Q2 earnings report, which disappointed investors.

sources.title: Meta's stock plunges almost 10% on disappointing guidance, dwindling free cash flow
Mark Zuckerberg predicts that billions of people will have personal AI agents in five years
Meta misses on Q2 earnings, stock tumbles

sections.heading: Earnings Report
paragraphs: According to CNBC, Meta's stock plunged almost 10% after the company provided disappointing guidance and reported dwindling free cash flow in its Q2 earnings report.

sections.heading: Market Reaction
paragraphs: Yahoo Finance reported that Meta missed expectations on Q2 earnings, leading to a tumble in its stock price.

sections.heading: Future Predictions
paragraphs: Despite the current downturn, TechCrunch highlighted Mark Zuckerberg's prediction that billions of people will have personal AI agents within five years, suggesting a continued focus on future technologies.

faq.a: Meta stock is trending due to a significant drop after the release of its Q2 earnings report, which showed disappointing guidance and dwindling free cash flow.
Mark Zuckerberg predicted that billions of people will have personal AI agents in five years, indicating a long-term vision for technology adoption.
